name: ctx_search
description:
Search code by regex. Prefer over native Grep/rg/find (compact output).
Respects .gitignore; supports multi-root via `paths` array. Secret-like files skipped unless role allows.

ignore_gitignore.description: Set true to scan ALL files including .gitignore'd paths (default: false). Requires role policy (e.g. admin).

paths.description: Multiple directories to search (alternative to path)
